handoff_to_synthesizing_claude:
  most_important_thing_to_carry_forward: >
    The five-sublayer Layer 5 architecture (5a weighted scoring / 5b K-axis
    admissibility / 5c stop-the-line / 5d post-render HPA / 5e Executive
    Committee Red-Pen Review). Layer 5e is the Morris Matrix discovery — the
    final pre-LOCK gate where 11-or-13 evaluators apply Q1-Q16 review
    questions; red-penned items return to lawful domain owners for revision;
    only after all red-pen items are dispositioned may technical.ust transition
    to LOCKED. This is canon-blocking for Mosaic v0 and for SUBSTRATE_SPEC_v0.1.
    The classifier-routing workspace and the validator-tactical workspace both
    need this to anchor their gate definitions; without it they will both ship
    a four-sublayer SEM and need rework.
  warning_about_misreading_this_workspace: >
    Do NOT promote forensic chain edges (RTFA/SEC/SDG/SLR/MMR) to substrate
    canon. All edges and all five Layer 5 sublayers explicitly carry CANDIDATE
    status pending operator F per FOIL discipline. The closing line of every
    forensic artifact reads "All edges remain CANDIDATE pending operator
    confirmation." Misreading: treating the forensic outputs as locked canon
    and writing SUBSTRATE_SPEC_v0.1 against them without OD-1 through OD-5 and
    OQ-6.1/6.2/6.3 operator closures. Second misread risk: treating the
    VIG/SEL/Reverse-UST/Stylebook dossier trio as MAESTRO v5 phase canon — the
    dossiers themselves state "DRAFT — pending Mo acceptance gate. Nothing in
    this document is canon until explicitly confirmed." Third misread risk:
    treating system_evolution_lineage_ledger.yaml as substitute for primary
    corpus rather than as the non-destructive bootstrap aid it is.
  recommended_next_slice_from_this_workspace_perspective: >
    evidence-contract. Rationale: the forensic chain produced a structurally
    corrected graph but five canon-blocking operator decisions (OD-1 through
    OD-5) plus three Morris Matrix sub-questions (OQ-6.1/6.2/6.3) remain
    open-Q-without-F. The Triad-validator slice that the other Claude session
    shipped is downstream of substrate lock — it will validate against
    profiles (v4_2_3 / v4_5_2 / v0_spec) but those profiles depend on the
    worker schema (OD-1), the K-vs-Q resolution (OQ-6.3), and the executive
    committee composition (OQ-6.1). Until evidence-contract closure runs,
    validator-tactical will build on candidate authority. Classifier-routing
    depends on phase machine + worker registry, both blocked on same set.
    Evidence-contract is the only slice that can unblock the other two.
